purpose: Draws and edits the Relations and Contact-preferences fields of a stakeholder card from the ontology's field set.
namedChanges: 0.1.1 (H14): `onOpenRef` takes a second, optional argument: the value the clicked link shows (the record's full address), so the host can name the vault the record is in. `(id) => void` callers stay valid. Not in the source.

The imports are the peers': `card-group` (`CardGroup`, `CardIcon`, `CardIconName`), `card-mode` (`useCardMode`), `card-references` (the link-target functions, `relationCopyOf`, `useAddCardReference`, `useRemoveCardReference`), `entity-ref-value`, `lws-records` (the type `RecordFacts`), `remove-control`, `stakeholder-card-model` (`storedValuesOf`, `termName`, `CardField`), `stakeholder-card-vocabulary` (`referenceReadingQuery`) and `stakeholder-field-sets` (types); `@tanstack/react-query` stays a third-party import; plus `./setFieldsHost`.

In `SetField`, before the first hook of the source: `const host = useStakeholderSetFieldsHost();` and `if (!host.changeRecordFactItems) recordId = null;`. `useRemoveCardReference()` is `useRemoveCardReference(host as CardReferencesHost)`.

ADDED BEHAVIOUR (production always has the writer): a host without `changeRecordFactItems` gets the fields read-only. Before: `recordId` is what the caller passes and the remove controls are drawn. After: `recordId` is `null` when the host has no writer, so no remove control is drawn and `remove` returns. With the writer nothing changes.
Comments that name a cycle, a ticket, an agent, a person, a ruling or the other app are reworded; no code changed.
